_doc: Requirements catalogue for action-receipt.md. `anchor` is text copied verbatim from the spec; conformance/trace.py --check verifies it still occurs there. Edit this file directly, then run conformance/trace.py --render.

requirements.text: Perform the steps in order and stop at the first failure.
requirements.anchor: The verifier MUST perform the steps below **in order** and MUST stop at the first failure.
requirements.note: every negative vector is one mutation of a valid receipt, so its expected reason is the first failing step; the fuzzer compares the reason two implementations give for multi-fault inputs

requirements.text: Do not raise on malformed input.
requirements.anchor: It MUST NOT raise on malformed input.
requirements.note: property P6: no generated case may produce ERROR or an undeclared reason

requirements.text: Do not report a verifier fault as a rejection.
requirements.anchor: `ERROR` says nothing about the receipt and MUST NOT be reported as a rejection.

requirements.text: Reject a receipt that is not a JWS-format object with three base64url segments and a JSON-object header.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_payload` unless the receipt is an object with `format == "jws"`

requirements.text: Accept only the one base64url spelling of a byte string.
requirements.anchor: re-encoding the decoded bytes MUST reproduce the string

requirements.text: Decode the header strictly as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark; never let a parser detect the encoding.
requirements.anchor: A parser that detects encodings from the bytes MUST NOT be given the bytes.

requirements.text: Reject unless `typ` is `x402-action-receipt+jws`.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_typ` unless the header's `typ` is

requirements.text: Never verify an action receipt as a base receipt or the reverse.
requirements.anchor: A verifier MUST NOT verify an action receipt as a base receipt or the reverse

requirements.text: Reject unless `alg` is ES256, ES256K or EdDSA.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_alg` unless `alg` is

requirements.text: Reject unless the header has exactly `alg`, `kid`, `typ` and `kid` is a string.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_payload` unless the header has exactly the members

requirements.text: Reject payload bytes that are not valid UTF-8 JSON.
requirements.anchor: `B` is valid UTF-8 and parses as JSON (RFC 8259)

requirements.text: Reject a payload outside the value domain: unsafe integers, unpaired surrogates, nesting deeper than 8.
requirements.anchor: the parsed value lies in the value domain of §4.6

requirements.text: Reject payload bytes that are not exactly the JCS form of their value.
requirements.anchor: `JCS(parsed value) == B`, byte for byte

requirements.text: Check canonical bytes before any typing, and let any canonical JSON value through to the schema step.
requirements.anchor: This step comes **before** any typing

requirements.text: Reject unless the payload is an object with exactly the listed members and an integer `version`.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_payload` unless the value is an object with exactly the members of §4.1

requirements.text: Reject any `version` other than 1, before interpreting other members.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_actionreceipt_version` unless `version == 1`

requirements.text: Reject a member of the wrong type or outside its grammar.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_payload` unless `action` is an object with exactly the members of §4.2

requirements.text: Reject a signed member that is out of grammar; never repair it (EVM identifiers must already be lowercase).
requirements.anchor: A signed member that does not match its grammar is rejected; it is never repaired.

requirements.text: Compare strings as exact code-point sequences; apply no normalization to signed members.
requirements.anchor: No Unicode normalization, case folding, percent-decoding or URL normalization is applied to any signed member.

requirements.text: Accept each listed `outcome` and reject any other.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_actionreceipt_outcome` unless `action.outcome` is a listed value

requirements.text: Accept each listed `settlementStatus` and reject any other.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_actionreceipt_status` unless `settlementStatus` is a listed value

requirements.text: Reject a `bindings` array that breaks the entry shape, grammar, order, uniqueness or count.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_actionreceipt_binding` unless `bindings` satisfies §4.5

requirements.text: Do not reject a receipt for an unrecognized binding type; report it as not evaluated.
requirements.anchor: A verifier MUST NOT reject a receipt because it does not recognize a binding type.

requirements.text: No binding status changes the verdict.
requirements.anchor: No binding status changes the verdict.

requirements.text: Evaluate `action-receipt:advertised-info` when the advertised `info` is held: digest, then `scope` and `actionType` equality.
requirements.anchor: `matched` iff the digest is equal and, for each of `scope` and `actionType` present in `info`, the receipt's `action` member is equal

requirements.text: Reject unless `kid` is authorized for the receipt's resource by the service or the recipient anchor.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_signer` unless `kid` is authorized for the receipt's `resourceUrl`

requirements.text: Treat both anchors as scoped to the resource.
requirements.anchor: Both anchors are scoped to the resource.

requirements.text: Do not dereference a location that only the receipt names.
requirements.anchor: It MUST NOT dereference a location that only the receipt names.

requirements.text: In archival mode, judge authorization as of `issuedAt`.
requirements.anchor: In `archival` mode the question is whether the key was authorized when the receipt was issued

requirements.text: Report an authorized key that cannot be obtained or parsed as unresolved, not as a bad signature.
requirements.anchor: reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_key_unresolved`

requirements.text: Verify the signature over the first two segments under the resolved key.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_signature` unless the signature verifies over

requirements.text: Require the key's type and curve to match `alg`.
requirements.anchor: the key's type and curve match `alg`

requirements.text: Require 64-byte low-s ECDSA signatures.
requirements.anchor: ECDSA signatures are the 64-byte `r || s` form of RFC 7518 §3.4 and MUST be low-`s`

requirements.text: Reject unless settlement succeeded and provides an identifier.
requirements.anchor: Reject with `invalid_transaction_state` unless the `SettlementResponse` has `success == true`

requirements.text: The receipt's `transaction` equals the response's when the response has one.
requirements.anchor: If the response has a `transaction`, the receipt's `transaction` equals it.

requirements.text: The receipt carries no `transaction` the response does not have.
requirements.anchor: If the response has none, the receipt's `transaction` is `""`.

requirements.text: The receipt's `settlementRef` equals the response's settlement reference when it has one.
requirements.anchor: If the response has a settlement reference, the receipt's `settlementRef` equals it.

requirements.text: Compare `network` when the response's is in CAIP-2 form.
requirements.anchor: If the response's `network` is in CAIP-2 form, the receipt's `network` equals it.

requirements.text: Compare `payer` when the response has one; otherwise record that it was not compared.
requirements.anchor: If the response has a `payer`, the receipt's `payer` equals it.

requirements.text: Lowercase the response's `transaction` and `payer` on `eip155` networks before comparing.
requirements.anchor: it lowercases the response's `transaction` and `payer`

requirements.text: Treat an absent member, `null` and the empty string alike as 'has none'.
requirements.anchor: an absent member, `null` and `""` all mean it has none

requirements.text: When the accepted requirements are held, `requirementsDigest` must equal their digest.
requirements.anchor: `requirementsDigest` equals the digest computed per §4.4

requirements.text: The accepted `network` must equal the receipt's.
requirements.anchor: `accepted.network` equals the receipt's `network`

requirements.text: The accepted `payTo`, lowercased on `eip155`, must equal the receipt's.
requirements.anchor: `accepted.payTo`, lowercased on `eip155` networks, equals the receipt's `payTo`

requirements.text: When requirements are not held, or are not a JSON object in the value domain, record that they were not evaluated.
requirements.anchor: records `requirements: not_evaluated` and `payTo: not_compared`

requirements.text: Judge numbers by value, not spelling: `60.0` is the integer 60.
requirements.anchor: The test is on the number's value, not its spelling

requirements.text: Reject a receipt dated more than 60 seconds in the future, in both modes.
requirements.anchor: In both modes, reject with `invalid_actionreceipt_freshness` if `age < -60`.

requirements.text: In session mode, reject a receipt older than the maximum age.
requirements.anchor: In `session` mode, also reject if `age > maxAge`.

requirements.text: In archival mode, report age and do not reject on it.
requirements.anchor: In `archival` mode age is not a reason to reject.

requirements.text: Return the report with every PASS.
requirements.anchor: A verifier MUST make at least this available:
requirements.note: the full report of every positive vector is compared with the manifest, and the reports that carry a 'not compared' or 'not evaluated' reading are also declared by hand in the suite

requirements.text: `receiptRef` is the hash of the payload bytes and covers neither header nor signature.
requirements.anchor: so the same statement signed under two keys has one `receiptRef`
requirements.note: sameReceiptRef and distinctReceiptRef relations in the manifest; fuzz property P1

requirements.text: Two payments that differ only in `receiptId` are two receipts.
requirements.anchor: It exists so that two payments which share every other member are still two receipts.

requirements.text: Every signed member is covered: changing any one changes `receiptRef`, and the members the context constrains are rejected.
requirements.anchor: Each signed member of a positive is changed once and re-signed.
requirements.note: the 17-member mutation matrix, with a guard that fails a mutation that changes nothing

requirements.text: A verifier that made the payment rejects a receipt whose `resourceUrl` is not the URL it paid for.
requirements.anchor: `invalid_actionreceipt_resource_mismatch` unless the receipt's `resourceUrl` equals, as an exact string, the resource URL it paid for

requirements.text: A non-requesting verifier says that its inputs were recorded copies.
requirements.anchor: It MUST say so when it reports a result

requirements.text: When resolving on the rail, confirm the chain, success, asset, amount, payer and recipient.
requirements.anchor: A verifier that does so SHOULD confirm that the node serves the chain named by `network`

requirements.text: Do not assume the transaction's submitter is the payee.
requirements.anchor: It SHOULD NOT assume the transaction's submitter is the payee

requirements.text: Pass the conformance suite before reporting a canonicalization rejection against an issuer.
requirements.anchor: A verifier SHOULD pass the conformance suite (§7) before reporting one against an issuer.

requirements.text: Retain the key and authorization evidence relied on, with the resolution time.
requirements.anchor: Verifiers that retain receipts SHOULD retain the key and the authorization evidence they relied on

requirements.text: Advertise the extension in `PaymentRequired`.
requirements.anchor: A resource server that will issue receipts SHOULD advertise the extension

requirements.text: Carry the advertised `actionType` and `scope` in the receipt, and commit the advertisement with a binding.
requirements.anchor: the receipt it later issues MUST carry the same values

requirements.text: May emit both a base receipt and an action receipt.
requirements.anchor: A server MAY emit both a base receipt and an action receipt.

requirements.text: When both are emitted, their common members are equal.
requirements.anchor: and `transaction` when the base receipt carries one) MUST be equal

requirements.text: Build each member from the source the table names.
requirements.anchor: The Source column is normative for the issuer

requirements.text: Generate `receiptId` with at least 128 bits of secure randomness and never reuse one.
requirements.anchor: The issuer MUST generate at least 128 bits of it from a cryptographically secure source and MUST NOT reuse a value.

requirements.text: Carry no settlement identifier that settlement did not return.
requirements.anchor: A receipt MUST NOT carry an identifier the server did not receive from settlement.

requirements.text: Carry a reversal or refund transaction in the reversal binding.
requirements.anchor: the server SHOULD carry it in the `action-receipt:reversal-transaction` binding

requirements.text: Hash only accepted requirements that lie in the value domain.
requirements.anchor: `accepted` MUST lie in the value domain of §4.6.

requirements.text: Issue no receipt when the digest cannot be computed.
requirements.anchor: MUST NOT issue a receipt for that payment

requirements.text: A binding does not restate or contradict a core member.
requirements.anchor: A binding MUST NOT restate or contradict a member of §4.1.

requirements.text: Use a signing key separate from the `payTo` key.
requirements.anchor: A dedicated signing key separate from the `payTo` key is RECOMMENDED

requirements.text: Use pseudonymous `agent` and `scope` where possible.
requirements.anchor: `agent` and `scope` SHOULD be pseudonymous where the use case allows.

requirements.text: Read `settlementStatus`; a passing receipt does not mean 'paid'.
requirements.anchor: A verifier or consumer MUST NOT read a passing receipt as "paid": it MUST read `settlementStatus`.

requirements.text: Do not read payment status as delivery evidence, or outcome as payment evidence.
requirements.anchor: It MUST NOT read `settlementStatus` as evidence about delivery

requirements.text: Obtain the latest receipt or resolve on the rail when current state matters.
requirements.anchor: a consumer that needs the current state MUST obtain the latest receipt

requirements.text: Do not treat a binding that was not evaluated, or mismatched, as verified.
requirements.anchor: A consumer MUST NOT treat a `not_evaluated` or `mismatched` binding as verified.

requirements.text: Count payments by network and settlement identifier, never by `receiptRef` or `receiptId`.
requirements.anchor: A consumer that counts payments MUST key on

requirements.text: Do not treat an unresolved key as a finding against the signer.
requirements.anchor: A consumer MUST NOT treat it as a finding against the signer.

requirements.text: Do not read PASS as covering what the report marks not compared or not evaluated.
requirements.anchor: A consumer MUST NOT read `PASS` as covering anything the report marks

requirements.text: Do not use a client-chosen identifier as the sole link between receipt and settlement.
requirements.anchor: MUST NOT be used as the sole link between a receipt and a settlement

requirements.text: A requesting verifier supplies the URL it paid for.
requirements.anchor: MUST supply the URL it paid for
